image_description: A macro close-up shot featuring two white daisy-like flowers against a dark background. The flower on the left is partially visible, showing layered white petals and a glimpse of a yellow center. The flower on the right is more prominent but slightly out of focus in the lower right quadrant, displaying a bright yellow center and radiating white petals. The lighting is soft, highlighting the texture and translucency of the petals.
